# FunDS Lite — Design System Specification
# Version: 1.0.0 | Updated: 2026-04
# Fetch this file to get the complete system spec in one request.
# Human manifest: https://funds-lite.vercel.app

---

## OVERVIEW

FunDS Lite is the lightweight subset of the Amartha FunDS design system.
It covers just enough tokens, components, and patterns to keep the mobile app
and internal dashboard in sync. The brand anchors in a single purple (#853291) —
every primary action, link, and active state uses this color.

Surfaces: Mobile (primary), Internal Dashboard

---

## PRODUCT CONTEXT

Amartha Financial (https://amartha.com/) — micro-finance lending for grassroot women in Indonesia.

Products:
- Modal         — Digital productive loan (primary borrower product)
- Group Loan    — Non-digital group loan (deprecated; migrating to Modal)
- Celengan      — Retail investment, grassroot market
- GGS           — Grassroot Growth Series, retail investment middle-upper class
- B2B Funding   — Institutional funding (not in AmarthaFin App)
- PPOB / AmarthaLink — B2C bill payment & agent-based PPOB
- Poket         — In-app wallet for Amartha ecosystem

Platforms:
- AmarthaFin App  — Consumer iOS/Android (borrowers, investors, PPOB users)
- NG-MIS          — Internal ops system / potential CRM
- A-Partner App   — Internal app for field partners/agents

---

## TOKENS — COLORS

### Brand (Primary Purple)

--primary-50:  #FEF3FF  — badge fills, focus rings, ghost hover backgrounds
--primary-200: #E5B8EF  — focus ring outer glow
--primary-300: #D68EE4  — illustrative / decorative
--primary-400: #A642B7  — secondary decorative actions
--primary-500: #853291  — PRIMARY — buttons, links, active states
--primary-600: #732C7C  — hover / pressed state
--primary-700: #612966  — on-light text emphasis
--primary-900: #3D1042  — deep emphasis

### Neutral

--neutral-white: #FFFFFF  — surface / card backgrounds
--neutral-50:    #F9FAF8  — page background
--neutral-200:   #E5E7EB  — borders (default)
--neutral-400:   #C6CAD0  — placeholder text
--neutral-500:   #8E95A3  — disabled state
--neutral-600:   #6B7280  — caption / secondary text
--neutral-700:   #525C6A  — secondary text emphasis
--neutral-900:   #111928  — default text (darkest)

### Status Colors

Always pair the 500 foreground with its 50-tint background.
Never use a status color on white or neutral-50 without the tint.

--blue-50:    #EDF7FF  |  --blue-500:    #056DCE  — informational
--green-50:   #E4FCEF  |  --green-500:   #009C6A  — success / funded
--orange-50:  #FDF4E9  |  --orange-500:  #F7941D  — warning / pending
--red-50:     #FFF4F3  |  --red-500:     #D73630  — error / overdue / danger
--yellow-50:  #FFFED9  |  --yellow-500:  #EAB20B  — accent / review

### Semantic Token Aliases

Use these names in component code — prefer over raw hex.

text-default:     --neutral-900 (#111928)  — primary readable text
text-caption:     --neutral-600 (#6B7280)  — secondary / supporting text
text-disabled:    --neutral-500 (#8E95A3)  — disabled labels
text-placeholder: --neutral-400 (#C6CAD0)  — input placeholder text
text-link:        --primary-500 (#853291)  — clickable links

border-default:   --neutral-200 (#E5E7EB)  — card and input borders
border-light:     --neutral-50  (#F9FAF8)  — subtle dividers

bg-overlay:       rgba(17, 25, 40, 0.8)   — modal / drawer overlays

---

## TOKENS — TYPOGRAPHY

Font Family: Inter (Google Fonts) — var(--font)
Weights: 500 (body), 700 (headings/buttons) — NO OTHER WEIGHTS PERMITTED

### Type Scale

text-24: 24px / weight 700 / letter-spacing -0.02em  → Page titles / primary headings
text-20: 20px / weight 700 / letter-spacing -0.01em  → Section headings
text-18: 18px / weight 500 / letter-spacing 0        → Primary reading size (dashboards)
text-16: 16px / weight 500 / letter-spacing 0        → Secondary paragraphs and descriptions
text-14: 14px / weight 500 / letter-spacing 0        → Compact data tables and labels
text-12: 12px / weight 500 / letter-spacing 0        → Body / caption / helper text
text-10: 10px / weight 500 / letter-spacing +0.06em  → Overline / micro (UPPERCASE only)

---

## TOKENS — SPACING & SHAPES

Base rhythm: 4px | Tailwind class suffix = pixel value

space-0:  0px   (p-0,  m-0)
space-2:  2px   (p-2,  m-2)
space-4:  4px   (p-4,  m-4)
space-8:  8px   (p-8,  m-8)
space-12: 12px  (p-12, m-12)
space-16: 16px  (p-16, m-16)
space-20: 20px  (p-20, m-20)
space-24: 24px  (p-24, m-24)
space-32: 32px  (p-32, m-32)
space-40: 40px  (p-40, m-40)
space-48: 48px  (p-48, m-48)

FORBIDDEN: 5, 6, 10, 15, 25, 30px — never use values not in the scale above.

### Border Radius

rounded-6:    6px     — chips, small tags
rounded-8:    8px     — inputs, selects, textareas (DEFAULT interactive)
rounded-12:   12px    — cards, modals, drawers
rounded-full: 9999px  — buttons and badges (pill shape)

### Layout Patterns

page-padding-x:   16px  — horizontal edge margin for all screen content
page-padding-top: 16px  — below topbar
section-gap:      12px  — vertical gap between cards/sections
card-padding:     12px  — internal card padding (not 20px)
card-gap:         8px   — gap between cards
topbar-height:    48px
topbar-padding-x: 16px

---

## SURFACES

Level 0 — Page Background:  #F9FAF8  (--neutral-50)    — primary page / screen background
Level 1 — Surface / Card:   #FFFFFF  (--neutral-white)  — card and modal backgrounds
       — Brand Tint:         #FEF3FF  (--primary-50)     — badge fills, ghost hover, focus rings
       — Overlay:            rgba(17, 25, 40, 0.8)       — modal / drawer overlays

---

## COMPONENTS

### Button
Shape:    pill (border-radius 9999px)
Variants: primary | secondary | outline (tertiary) | ghost | danger
Sizes:    xs (12px) | sm (12px) | md (14px) | lg (16px) | xl (16px)
States:   default | hover | active | focus-visible | disabled
Font:     weight 700
Implementation: src/funds-lite/components/Button.tsx
React API: <Button variant="primary" size="md">Label</Button>
Props: variant, size — accepts native button props (disabled, type, onClick)

Token map:
- primary:   bg var(--primary-500) + gradient, hover var(--primary-600), text white
             box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--primary-600), 0 2px 3px rgba(133,50,145,0.3)
- secondary: bg white, border var(--primary-500), text var(--primary-500), hover var(--primary-50) tint
- outline:   bg white, border var(--neutral-200), text var(--neutral-900), hover var(--neutral-400) border
- ghost:     bg transparent, text var(--primary-500), hover bg var(--primary-50)
- danger:    bg var(--red-500), border var(--red-500), text white, hover var(--red-600)

Disabled: var(--neutral-200) bg, var(--neutral-500) text, cursor not-allowed, no shadow
Focus ring: 2px white + 4px var(--primary-200) (#E5B8EF)

### Input
Radius: 8px | Border: var(--neutral-200) | Focus: border var(--primary-500) + 3px var(--primary-50) ring
Implementation: src/funds-lite/components/Input.tsx
React API: <Input label="Amount" prefix="Rp" placeholder="Type here" />
Sizes: sm | md | lg
States: default | focus | valid | error | disabled
Conditions: empty | filled
Additional info: label | required | optionalText | helperText | description
Prefix/suffix: clickable via prefixInteractive/suffixInteractive + prefixButtonProps/suffixButtonProps
Icons: left or right when meaningful or actionable
Variants: text input | select | textarea | tap area

State token map:
- default:  border var(--neutral-200)
- focus:    border var(--primary-500), ring var(--primary-50) 3px
- valid:    border var(--green-500)
- error:    border var(--red-500), ring var(--red-50) 3px

### Badge
Shape: pill (border-radius 9999px) | Padding: 3px 10px | Font: 12px / weight 500

Variant token map:
- primary: bg var(--primary-50) (#FEF3FF),  text var(--primary-600) (#732C7C)
- blue:    bg var(--blue-50)    (#EDF7FF),  text var(--blue-600)    (#0457A5)
- green:   bg var(--green-50)   (#E4FCEF),  text var(--green-600)   (#007D55)
- orange:  bg var(--orange-50)  (#FDF4E9),  text var(--orange-700)  (#AD540A)
- red:     bg var(--red-50)     (#FFF4F3),  text var(--red-600)     (#AC2B26)
- yellow:  bg var(--yellow-50)  (#FFFED9),  text var(--yellow-700)  (#996F03)
- neutral: bg var(--neutral-50) (#F9FAF8),  text var(--neutral-600) (#6B7280)

### Card
Radius: 12px | Border: 1px solid var(--neutral-200) | Background: var(--neutral-white) | Padding: 12px
Never nest cards. Use to group related fund information.

---

## DO / DON'T GUARDRAILS

DO:
✓ Use var(--primary-500) (#853291) for all primary actions, links, and active states
✓ Pair every status color with its 50-tint background (e.g. var(--red-500) text on var(--red-50) bg)
✓ Use Inter at weight 500 or 700 only — no other weights
✓ Use spacing values from the defined scale (0,2,4,8,12,16,20,24,32,40,48px)
✓ Use the mobile layout guide: 16px page padding, 12px section gaps, 12px card padding, 8px card gaps
✓ Use semantic alias names (text-default, border-default) over raw hex in component code
✓ Use rounded-full (9999px) for buttons/badges, rounded-8 for inputs, rounded-12 for cards

DON'T:
✗ Never use arbitrary Tailwind values like w-[437px] or text-[#abc]
✗ Never invent hex values not in this token set
✗ Never use font-weight 400, 600, or 800
✗ Never use spacing values not in the defined scale (e.g. 5px, 10px, 15px)
✗ Never use Google Fonts other than Inter
✗ Never use purple from generic Tailwind palettes — only var(--primary-*) tokens
✗ Never use a status color on white without the tint bg pair
✗ Never use emoji in the design

---

## AGENT PROMPT GUIDE

Quick token reference:
- Primary action:  var(--primary-500) #853291
- Primary hover:   var(--primary-600) #732C7C
- Text default:    var(--neutral-900) #111928
- Page background: var(--neutral-50)  #F9FAF8
- Card surface:    var(--neutral-white) #FFFFFF
- Border:          var(--neutral-200)  #E5E7EB

Example component prompts:

1. Fund Dashboard Card:
   "Build a React card with var(--neutral-white) bg, rounded-12, 1px solid var(--neutral-200) border,
   12px padding. Fund name in text-16 weight 700 (var(--neutral-900)), AUM/IRR stats in text-14 weight 500.
   Status badge using Badge component with variant matching fund state."

2. Primary Action Button:
   "var(--primary-500) background, white text, rounded-full (9999px), text-14 weight 700, 8px 12px padding.
   Hover shifts to var(--primary-600). Use <Button variant='primary'>Label</Button>."

3. Data Table:
   "text-14 weight 500 (var(--neutral-900)), var(--neutral-200) bottom border per row,
   var(--neutral-50) header background. Status column uses Badge component."

4. Amount Input with Prefix:
   "<Input label='Amount' prefix='Rp' prefixInteractive prefixButtonProps={{ 'aria-label': 'Choose currency' }}
   placeholder='0' /> — radius 8px, border var(--neutral-200), focus ring var(--primary-500) + var(--primary-50)."

5. Topbar:
   "48px height, var(--neutral-white) background, 1px solid var(--neutral-200) border-bottom.
   Logo in var(--primary-500). Nav items text-14 weight 500 (var(--neutral-600)), active in
   var(--neutral-900) weight 700."

## QUICK START — CSS CUSTOM PROPERTIES

:root {
  /* Brand */
  --primary-50:  #FEF3FF;
  --primary-200: #E5B8EF;
  --primary-300: #D68EE4;
  --primary-400: #A642B7;
  --primary-500: #853291;
  --primary-600: #732C7C;
  --primary-700: #612966;
  --primary-900: #3D1042;

  /* Neutral */
  --neutral-white: #FFFFFF;
  --neutral-50:    #F9FAF8;
  --neutral-200:   #E5E7EB;
  --neutral-400:   #C6CAD0;
  --neutral-500:   #8E95A3;
  --neutral-600:   #6B7280;
  --neutral-700:   #525C6A;
  --neutral-900:   #111928;

  /* Status */
  --blue-50:     #EDF7FF;  --blue-500:    #056DCE;  --blue-600:    #0457A5;
  --green-50:    #E4FCEF;  --green-500:   #009C6A;  --green-600:   #007D55;
  --orange-50:   #FDF4E9;  --orange-500:  #F7941D;  --orange-700:  #AD540A;
  --red-50:      #FFF4F3;  --red-500:     #D73630;  --red-600:     #AC2B26;
  --yellow-50:   #FFFED9;  --yellow-500:  #EAB20B;  --yellow-700:  #996F03;

  /* Typography */
  --font: 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;

  /* Layout */
  --page-padding-x:   16px;
  --page-padding-top: 16px;
  --section-gap:      12px;
  --card-padding:     12px;
  --card-gap:         8px;
  --topbar-height:    48px;
  --topbar-padding-x: 16px;
}
